Drive Partner collects partner profile, vehicle, private KYC object keys, and duty-active GPS telemetry solely to operate ride/delivery dispatch, trip billing, safety SOS, and payouts. Raw 12-digit Aadhaar numbers are never stored or logged.

Partners must maintain valid driving licenses, vehicle registration, and insurance. All fares, commissions, incentives, and ledger payouts are governed by authoritative server records. Active trips must be completed or resolved before signing out.

While you are set to Online Duty or on an active trip, Drive Partner runs a visible foreground location service to receive nearby dispatch offers, track trip routes, and support SOS alerts. No location tracking occurs while Offline.
